source_text: I think you’re turning a new leaf, Melissa.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.I think you’re turning a new leaf, Melissa.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.I think you’re turning a new leaf, Melissa."

translation: Chyba przechodzisz przemianę, Melisso.

source_text: Seems you’re actually listening to me.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.Seems you’re actually listening to me.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.Seems you’re actually listening to me."

translation: Wygląda na to, że naprawdę mnie słuchasz.

source_text: If you’re suggesting that I don’t listen, you’re dead wrong.

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.If you’re suggesting that I don’t listen, you’re dead wrong.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.If you’re suggesting that I don’t listen, you’re dead wrong."

translation: Jeśli sugerujesz, że nie słucham, to grubo się mylisz.

source_text: Why do you have to be so difficult? It would make both our lives easier if you just relaxed once in a while.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.Why do you have to be so difficult? It would make both our lives easier if you just relaxed once in a while.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.Why do you have to be so difficult? It would make both our lives easier if you just relaxed once in a while."

translation: Dlaczego musisz być taka trudna? Obojgu byłoby łatwiej, gdybyś czasem odpuściła.

source_text: Stop trying to push my buttons and start searching.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.Stop trying to push my buttons and start searching.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.Stop trying to push my buttons and start searching."

translation: Przestań naciskać mi guziki i zacznij szukać.

source_text: Whatever you say, boss.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.Whatever you say, boss.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.Whatever you say, boss."

translation: Jak sobie życzysz, szefowo.

source_text: How do we open it? Is there a key?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.How do we open it? Is there a key?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.How do we open it? Is there a key?"

translation: Jak to otworzyć? Jest jakiś klucz?

source_text: It’s a combination safe… The code probably died with Zephaniah.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.It’s a combination safe… The code probably died with Zephaniah.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.It’s a combination safe… The code probably died with Zephaniah."

translation: To sejf szyfrowy… Kod pewnie umarł razem z Zephaniahem.

source_text: We might have to brute force it.

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.We might have to brute force it.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.We might have to brute force it."

translation: Może będziemy musieli go sforsować.

source_text: Well, shit. That’ll take a while.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Well, shit. That’ll take a while.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Well, shit. That’ll take a while."

translation: No cholera. To trochę potrwa.

source_text: Hey. Where are you going?

structure.raw_value: McShOp.Hey. Where are you going?
structure.script_literal: "McShOp.Hey. Where are you going?"

translation: Hej. Dokąd idziesz?

source_text: We’re not going to open it right now.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.We’re not going to open it right now.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.We’re not going to open it right now."

translation: Nie otworzymy go teraz.

source_text: But there are other things we could do.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.But there are other things we could do.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.But there are other things we could do."

translation: Ale są inne rzeczy, które moglibyśmy zrobić.

source_text: I don’t have time for this! I have to fix the roof, and fast!

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.I don’t have time for this! I have to fix the roof, and fast!
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.I don’t have time for this! I have to fix the roof, and fast!"

translation: Nie mam na to czasu! Muszę szybko naprawić dach!

source_text: The safe is locked. I’ll need to find a code if I’m going to open it up.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp#>.The safe is locked. I’ll need to find a code if I’m going to open it up.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp#>.The safe is locked. I’ll need to find a code if I’m going to open it up."

translation: Sejf jest zamknięty. Będę musiał znaleźć kod, jeśli mam go otworzyć.

source_text: I can’t believe I figured it out.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.I can’t believe I figured it out.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.I can’t believe I figured it out."

translation: Nie mogę uwierzyć, że to rozgryzłem.

source_text: It’s the medicine! This is what Melissa said we needed.

structure.raw_value: McShOp#>.It’s the medicine! This is what Melissa said we needed.
structure.script_literal: "McShOp#>.It’s the medicine! This is what Melissa said we needed."

translation: To lekarstwo! To właśnie Melissa mówiła, że potrzebujemy.

source_text: I’ll hold onto this and show it to Melissa at work tomorrow.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I’ll hold onto this and show it to Melissa at work tomorrow.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I’ll hold onto this and show it to Melissa at work tomorrow."

translation: Zatrzymam to i pokażę Melissie w pracy jutro.

source_text: I wonder if all the lines in this old journal are as interesting as this.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp#>.I wonder if all the lines in this old journal are as interesting as this.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp#>.I wonder if all the lines in this old journal are as interesting as this."

translation: Ciekawe, czy wszystkie linijki w tym starym dzienniku są równie interesujące.

source_text: You got into the safe?

structure.raw_value: BrFrOp.You got into the safe?
structure.script_literal: "BrFrOp.You got into the safe?"

translation: Dostałeś się do sejfu?

source_text: Your advice worked. There was a note in the attic.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Your advice worked. There was a note in the attic.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Your advice worked. There was a note in the attic."

translation: Twoja rada zadziałała. Na strychu była notatka.

source_text: What I expected…

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.What I expected…
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.What I expected…"

translation: Tego się spodziewałem…

source_text: His heart medication was in here along with a personal journal.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.His heart medication was in here along with a personal journal.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.His heart medication was in here along with a personal journal."

translation: Jego lek na serce był tutaj razem z osobistym dziennikiem.

source_text: I hope they help in your investigation.

structure.raw_value: BrFrEx.I hope they help in your investigation.
structure.script_literal: "BrFrEx.I hope they help in your investigation."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że pomogą w śledztwie.

source_text: He didn’t have his medication in his system when he died…

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.He didn’t have his medication in his system when he died…
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.He didn’t have his medication in his system when he died…"

translation: Nie miał leku w organizmie, gdy umarł…

source_text: Perhaps he had turned to the Lord for medical advice.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.Perhaps he had turned to the Lord for medical advice.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.Perhaps he had turned to the Lord for medical advice."

translation: Może zwrócił się do Pana po poradę medyczną.

source_text: We’re not all that crazy, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: BrFlEx.We’re not all that crazy, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlEx.We’re not all that crazy, 1Hero."

translation: Nie wszyscy jesteśmy aż tak szaleni, 1Hero.

source_text: Let’s just hope we don’t find anything sinister in Zeph’s past.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Let’s just hope we don’t find anything sinister in Zeph’s past.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Let’s just hope we don’t find anything sinister in Zeph’s past."

translation: Miejmy nadzieję, że nie znajdziemy nic złowieszczego w przeszłości Zepha.

source_text: If you find anything, please let me know.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.If you find anything, please let me know.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.If you find anything, please let me know."

translation: Jeśli coś znajdziesz, daj mi znać, proszę.

source_text: Of course, Father. You’ll be one of the first to know.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Of course, Father. You’ll be one of the first to know.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Of course, Father. You’ll be one of the first to know."

translation: Oczywiście, ojcze. Będziesz jednym z pierwszych, którzy się dowiedzą.

source_text: One of these days life will return to normal. But not yet.

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe.One of these days life will return to normal. But not yet.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe.One of these days life will return to normal. But not yet."

translation: Któregoś dnia życie wróci do normy. Ale jeszcze nie.

source_text: We’ll get through this, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: BrFrEx.We’ll get through this, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "BrFrEx.We’ll get through this, 1Hero."

translation: Przejdziemy przez to, 1Hero.

source_text: A quiet evening without Judy here.

structure.raw_value: BrFrOp.A quiet evening without Judy here.
structure.script_literal: "BrFrOp.A quiet evening without Judy here."

translation: Cichy wieczór bez Judy tutaj.

source_text: We’ll bring her back in one piece.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.We’ll bring her back in one piece.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.We’ll bring her back in one piece."

translation: Sprowadzimy ją całą i zdrową.

source_text: Judy seems full of vigor this morning.

structure.raw_value: BrFrEx.Judy seems full of vigor this morning.
structure.script_literal: "BrFrEx.Judy seems full of vigor this morning."

translation: Judy wydaje się dziś pełna wigoru.

source_text: We had a fun night.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.We had a fun night.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.We had a fun night."

translation: Mieliśmy fajną noc.

source_text: Careful not to have too much fun.

structure.raw_value: BrFlEx.Careful not to have too much fun.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlEx.Careful not to have too much fun."

translation: Uważaj, żeby nie bawić się za dobrze.

source_text: Did you speak to Tasha?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Did you speak to Tasha?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Did you speak to Tasha?"

translation: Rozmawiałeś z Tashą?

source_text: I don’t want to talk about it.

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe.I don’t want to talk about it.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe.I don’t want to talk about it."

translation: Nie chcę o tym rozmawiać.

source_text: Going to the Bible for Casula wisdom won’t work…

structure.raw_value: BrBaOp.Going to the Bible for Casula wisdom won’t work…
structure.script_literal: "BrBaOp.Going to the Bible for Casula wisdom won’t work…"

translation: Sięganie do Biblii po mądrość Casuli nie zadziała…

source_text: I need some help.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.I need some help.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.I need some help."

translation: Potrzebuję pomocy.

source_text: I’ll let Erica know.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I’ll let Erica know.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I’ll let Erica know."

translation: Dam znać Erice.

source_text: I must help Father study.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.I must help Father study.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.I must help Father study."

translation: Muszę pomóc ojcu w nauce.

source_text: Are you going to tell Chloe what happened?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Are you going to tell Chloe what happened?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Are you going to tell Chloe what happened?"

translation: Powiesz Chloe, co się stało?

source_text: For Chloe’s sake… perhaps not.

structure.raw_value: JuWoOp.For Chloe’s sake… perhaps not.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoOp.For Chloe’s sake… perhaps not."

translation: Dla dobra Chloe… może lepiej nie.

source_text: Big day tomorrow.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Big day tomorrow.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Big day tomorrow."

translation: Wielki dzień jutro.

source_text: We’ll get through this, 1Hero. God is with us.

structure.raw_value: BrFrOp.We’ll get through this, 1Hero. God is with us.
structure.script_literal: "BrFrOp.We’ll get through this, 1Hero. God is with us."

translation: Przejdziemy przez to, 1Hero. Bóg jest z nami.

source_text: I’m getting too old for adventures.

structure.raw_value: BrSaDe.I’m getting too old for adventures.
structure.script_literal: "BrSaDe.I’m getting too old for adventures."

translation: Robię się za stary na przygody.

source_text: Any new adventures, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: BrFlOp.Any new adventures, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "BrFlOp.Any new adventures, 1Hero?"

translation: Jakieś nowe przygody, 1Hero?

source_text: You never know what’s just around the corner.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.You never know what’s just around the corner.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.You never know what’s just around the corner."

translation: Nigdy nie wiesz, co czai się za rogiem.

source_text: I hope we can find those amulets.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.I hope we can find those amulets.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.I hope we can find those amulets."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że uda nam się znaleźć te amulety.

source_text: Don’t worry. Like I said, I’m a treasure hunter. You can count on me when it comes to this kind of thing.

structure.raw_value: HrFrEx.Don’t worry. Like I said, I’m a treasure hunter. You can count on me when it comes to this kind of thing.
structure.script_literal: "HrFrEx.Don’t worry. Like I said, I’m a treasure hunter. You can count on me when it comes to this kind of thing."

translation: Spokojnie. Jak mówiłem, jestem łowcą skarbów. Możesz na mnie liczyć w takich sprawach.

source_text: I’ve been up for such a long time… I can hardly see straight.

structure.raw_value: HrWoOp.I’ve been up for such a long time… I can hardly see straight.
structure.script_literal: "HrWoOp.I’ve been up for such a long time… I can hardly see straight."

translation: Nie śpię od tak dawna… Ledwo widzę na oczy.

source_text: Dad! Wake the fuck up! We have the amulets!

structure.raw_value: TaHaEx.Dad! Wake the fuck up! We have the amulets!
structure.script_literal: "TaHaEx.Dad! Wake the fuck up! We have the amulets!"

translation: Tato! Obudź się, do cholery! Mamy amulety!

source_text: Tasha!? How long was I asleep?

structure.raw_value: BrWoCl.Tasha!? How long was I asleep?
structure.script_literal: "BrWoCl.Tasha!? How long was I asleep?"

translation: Tasha!? Jak długo spałem?

source_text: Don’t worry, I kept reading.

structure.raw_value: TaFlEx^.Don’t worry, I kept reading.
structure.script_literal: "TaFlEx^.Don’t worry, I kept reading."

translation: Nie martw się, czytałam dalej.

source_text: Father, we found the amulets. They were in the mansion.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Father, we found the amulets. They were in the mansion.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Father, we found the amulets. They were in the mansion."

translation: Ojcze, znaleźliśmy amulety. Były w rezydencji.

source_text: Great job!...

structure.raw_value: BrHaOp.Great job!...
structure.script_literal: "BrHaOp.Great job!..."

translation: Świetna robota!...

source_text: Now to figure out what it means.

structure.raw_value: BrFrEx.Now to figure out what it means.
structure.script_literal: "BrFrEx.Now to figure out what it means."

translation: Teraz trzeba rozgryźć, co to znaczy.

source_text: You need to encompass her in the three amulets.

structure.raw_value: TaBaEx^.You need to encompass her in the three amulets.
structure.script_literal: "TaBaEx^.You need to encompass her in the three amulets."

translation: Musisz otoczyć ją trzema amuletami.

source_text: Yeah… I read about it.

structure.raw_value: TaFlEx^.Yeah… I read about it.
structure.script_literal: "TaFlEx^.Yeah… I read about it."

translation: Tak… Czytałem o tym.

source_text: What does that mean exactly? How the hell do we lure her into a trap?

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.What does that mean exactly? How the hell do we lure her into a trap?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.What does that mean exactly? How the hell do we lure her into a trap?"

translation: Co to dokładnie znaczy? Jak, do cholery, zwabimy ją w pułapkę?

source_text: Can we surround the rift door with the amulets?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Can we surround the rift door with the amulets?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Can we surround the rift door with the amulets?"

translation: Możemy otoczyć drzwi Szczeliny amuletami?

source_text: What we need is a lasso gun.

structure.raw_value: TaFlEx^.What we need is a lasso gun.
structure.script_literal: "TaFlEx^.What we need is a lasso gun."

translation: Potrzebujemy pistoletu na lasso.

source_text: Your mom told you about the lasso gun!?

structure.raw_value: BrWoClNo1.Your mom told you about the lasso gun!?
structure.script_literal: "BrWoClNo1.Your mom told you about the lasso gun!?"

translation: Mama ci opowiedziała o pistolecie na lasso!?

source_text: Yeah. She used it to capture security guards at the bank.

structure.raw_value: TaFrEx^.Yeah. She used it to capture security guards at the bank.
structure.script_literal: "TaFrEx^.Yeah. She used it to capture security guards at the bank."

translation: Tak. Użyła go, by schwytać ochroniarzy w banku.

source_text: Oh… Yes… That’s what we used it for.

structure.raw_value: BrHaCl.Oh… Yes… That’s what we used it for.
structure.script_literal: "BrHaCl.Oh… Yes… That’s what we used it for."

translation: Och… Tak… Właśnie do tego go użyliśmy.

source_text: Do you have one?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Do you have one?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Do you have one?"

translation: Masz taki?

source_text: I can build one. It’s simple.

structure.raw_value: TaFrEx^.I can build one. It’s simple.
structure.script_literal: "TaFrEx^.I can build one. It’s simple."

translation: Mogę zbudować. To proste.

source_text: Are you sure about this? What does encompass mean? Do the amulets need to touch her?

structure.raw_value: BrBaOp.Are you sure about this? What does encompass mean? Do the amulets need to touch her?
structure.script_literal: "BrBaOp.Are you sure about this? What does encompass mean? Do the amulets need to touch her?"

translation: Jesteś tego pewien? Co znaczy otoczyć? Czy amulety muszą jej dotknąć?

source_text: No! That’s not what it said.

structure.raw_value: TaAnEx^.No! That’s not what it said.
structure.script_literal: "TaAnEx^.No! That’s not what it said."

translation: Nie! Nie tak było napisane.

source_text: How do we know she won't just escape?

structure.raw_value: BrAnDe.How do we know she won't just escape?
structure.script_literal: "BrAnDe.How do we know she won't just escape?"

translation: Skąd wiemy, że po prostu nie ucieknie?

source_text: Maybe you should think about that part.

structure.raw_value: TaAnEx^.Maybe you should think about that part.
structure.script_literal: "TaAnEx^.Maybe you should think about that part."

translation: Może powinieneś przemyśleć tę część.

source_text: Show me where you saw this written down. I don’t believe a Jewish book is going to talk about a lasso.

structure.raw_value: BrAnOp.Show me where you saw this written down. I don’t believe a Jewish book is going to talk about a lasso.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnOp.Show me where you saw this written down. I don’t believe a Jewish book is going to talk about a lasso."

translation: Pokaż mi, gdzie widziałeś to zapisane. Nie wierzę, że żydowska księga będzie mówić o lassie.

source_text: It didn’t talk about a lasso! That was my idea!

structure.raw_value: TaMaEx^.It didn’t talk about a lasso! That was my idea!
structure.script_literal: "TaMaEx^.It didn’t talk about a lasso! That was my idea!"

translation: Nie było tam mowy o lassie! To był mój pomysł!

source_text: Are you making this up?

structure.raw_value: BrAnDe.Are you making this up?
structure.script_literal: "BrAnDe.Are you making this up?"

translation: Wymyślasz to sobie?

source_text: Argh! I’ll show you!

structure.raw_value: TaMaEx^.Argh! I’ll show you!
structure.script_literal: "TaMaEx^.Argh! I’ll show you!"

translation: Argh! Pokażę ci!

source_text: Can we hurry this up?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Can we hurry this up?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Can we hurry this up?"

translation: Możemy to przyspieszyć?

source_text: Patience, 1Hero. The last thing we want is to give Lillian back the amulets because we didn’t know what to do with them.

structure.raw_value: BrWoEx.Patience, 1Hero. The last thing we want is to give Lillian back the amulets because we didn’t know what to do with them.
structure.script_literal: "BrWoEx.Patience, 1Hero. The last thing we want is to give Lillian back the amulets because we didn’t know what to do with them."

translation: Cierpliwości, 1Hero. Ostatnią rzeczą, jakiej chcemy, to oddać Lillian amulety, bo nie wiedzieliśmy, co z nimi zrobić.

source_text: He has a point.

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.He has a point.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.He has a point."

translation: Ma rację.

source_text: Let’s stop wasting time.

structure.raw_value: TaAnOp^.Let’s stop wasting time.
structure.script_literal: "TaAnOp^.Let’s stop wasting time."

translation: Przestańmy marnować czas.

source_text: This storm just won't stop.

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.This storm just won't stop.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.This storm just won't stop."

translation: Ta burza po prostu nie chce ustać.

source_text: If there’s still a world left after all of this, things are going to be different.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.If there’s still a world left after all of this, things are going to be different.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.If there’s still a world left after all of this, things are going to be different."

translation: Jeśli po tym wszystkim wciąż będzie istniał świat, wszystko będzie inaczej.

source_text: Kimberly Foxx is going to have a lot of content for her show.

structure.raw_value: MeFlDe.Kimberly Foxx is going to have a lot of content for her show.
structure.script_literal: "MeFlDe.Kimberly Foxx is going to have a lot of content for her show."

translation: Kimberly Foxx będzie miała mnóstwo materiału na swój program.

source_text: Heh. Years worth.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.Heh. Years worth.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.Heh. Years worth."

translation: Heh. Na lata.

source_text: I have to say, you’re far from boring, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: MeFlDe.I have to say, you’re far from boring, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "MeFlDe.I have to say, you’re far from boring, 1Hero."

translation: Muszę przyznać, że jesteś daleki od nudy, 1Hero.

source_text: Aren’t you glad you realized just how amazing I am?

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.Aren’t you glad you realized just how amazing I am?
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.Aren’t you glad you realized just how amazing I am?"

translation: Nie cieszysz się, że odkryłeś, jak niesamowity jestem?

source_text: You son of a bitch.

structure.raw_value: MeFlDe.You son of a bitch.
structure.script_literal: "MeFlDe.You son of a bitch."

translation: Ty skurwielu.

source_text: 1Hero? Are you going to help me or not?

structure.raw_value: TaAnOp^.1Hero? Are you going to help me or not?
structure.script_literal: "TaAnOp^.1Hero? Are you going to help me or not?"

translation: 1Hero? Pomożesz mi czy nie?

source_text: Oh, uhh… I just finished…

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Oh, uhh… I just finished…
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Oh, uhh… I just finished…"

translation: Och, yyy… Właśnie skończyłem…

source_text: Ain’t nothing to be embarrassed about.

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe^.Ain’t nothing to be embarrassed about.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe^.Ain’t nothing to be embarrassed about."

translation: Nie ma się czego wstydzić.

source_text: Come on… We better go keep an eye on poor Erica.

structure.raw_value: HeFrEx.Come on… We better go keep an eye on poor Erica.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrEx.Come on… We better go keep an eye on poor Erica."
